rationale: Parkinson and MIND sleep findings concern whole-diet scores or grouped beans. The regional studies measure legume preference or compare intake and sleep separately with a gut bacterium. A Pinta sprout experiment measures rat melatonin rather than sleep. The boiled-pinto crossover measured other outcomes, leaving the effect on clinical Parkinson insomnia unresolved.

Upper-limb tremor followed excess nutmeg in one report with tremor posture unspecified. The potentially overlapping Spanish reports describe intention tremor with conflicting medication histories, and a poison-center recorder judged a recorded tremor unrelated to exposure. Injected mouse extract studies report locomotor effects. Ordinary ground nutmeg and Parkinson rest-tremor severity remain unresolved.
